About Event

​Join Legacy Lounge at One Sansome, San Francisco, for an evening with General Partners from major VC firms.

​Our conversation spans B2B and enterprise software, AI, health, fintech, and frontier technologies — and the decisions that turn promising ideas into enduring businesses.

​The GP lineup is growing. Expect a cross-sector capital playbook: how top investors decide, what they fund, and what comes after the exit.

​Meet Omri Amirav-Drory, Ph.D.

​Scientist. Founder. Investor.

​Omri is a General Partner at NFX. He founded Genome Compiler and led it through its acquisition by Twist Bioscience, where he later headed corporate development. His investing and advisory experience includes Mammoth Biosciences, Immunai, and C2i Genomics. He holds a Ph.D. in biochemistry and completed postdoctoral research at Stanford.

​Capital

​Kayvan Baroumand

​Co-Founder & Advisor, SignalRank

​Kayvan co-founded SignalRank, which reports training its models on more than one million fundraising rounds. Former COO of Plug and Play and founder and former CEO of Nest GSV, he brings accelerator leadership and experience in systematic venture investing.

​Vaanyasri Goel

​Chief Investment Strategist, PACE Family Office

​Vaanyasri is Chief Investment Strategist at PACE Family Office. A member of the family’s third generation with experience at BlackRock, she brings an India–Silicon Valley perspective on venture investing, private equity, AI and investment governance.

​Venture Building

​Gautam M. Shah

​Chief Product and Strategy Officer, NextGen Healthcare

​Gautam, NextGen Healthcare’s Chief Product and Strategy Officer, brings 25 years of global experience in product management, AI and healthcare technology. Previously Chief Product Officer at Carelon, he holds 10 granted patents and serves on the board of San Francisco’s JCYC.

​Brendan Teehan

​Chief Commercial Officer, Pacira BioSciences

​Brendan Teehan is Chief Commercial Officer of Pacira BioSciences, with a 30-year track record building biopharma commercial teams. Previously COO & Head of Commercial at Acadia Pharmaceuticals; leadership roles at Tesaro, Amgen, and Johnson & Johnson. M.B.A., Carnegie Mellon.

​Jikhan Jung

​Advisor, CRIT Ventures | Former Corporate Vice President, Samsung Electronics

​Jikhan advises CRIT Ventures and co-founded Gala-Net, the online-game publisher acquired by Webzen in 2013. His experience spans company building, digital distribution and gaming platforms, including executive work at Samsung Electronics and roles at COLOPL and Kabam.

​

​Join us for a thoughtful conversation about building enduring companies, recognizing emerging opportunities, and the decisions that shape what comes next.

​The evening

​Fireside conversation: From scientific breakthroughs to enduring businesses.

​The Capital Playbook: GP perspectives across B2B, AI, health, fintech, and frontier technology. Additional investors will be announced as confirmed.

​Curated conversation and connections: An intimate room of founders, CXOs, investors, and experienced operators.

​Limited to 50 guests, with registration approval, so there is room for meaningful conversation.

​Request your place—we’d love to welcome you.

​Who Should Attend

​This gathering is designed for:

​Founders building AI-native, data-driven, health, technology, or infrastructure companies

​Venture investors, angels, family offices, and private-market allocators

​Exited founders exploring their next company, board role, or investment chapter

​Senior operators responsible for product, commercialization, partnerships, or growth

​Corporate innovation and strategic investment leaders

​Legal, banking, intellectual-property, and market-access professionals

​Selected ecosystem partners whose expertise contributes meaningfully to the room

​Past Legacy Lounge Speakers

​Arnaud Auger — Cathay Innovation / C.Lab
€2.5B AUM • $1B Fund III • 120+ portfolio companies

​Brett Horton — CIO, Paris-Roubaix Group
Single-family office • VC, PE, hedge funds & alternatives

​Kayvan Baroumand — Founder, SignalRank
Former COO, Plug and Play • Former CEO, GSV Labs

​Omri Amirav-Drory, PhD — GP, NFX
$450M fund • $500K–$5M checks • Founder exit to Twist Bioscience

​Ray Wu — Managing Partner, AI Fund, Alumni Ventures
20+ years investing • Former HP & Cisco corporate venture

​Rio Hodges — Associate Partner, Antler US
Antler: $1B+ AUM • Day-zero investing

​​Partnership & Sponsorship Inquiries

​Legacy Lounge works selectively with brands and firms that add meaningful value to the room. Request here.

​​HOST

​Teresa Ge

​Teresa founded Succedia Ventures and created Legacy Lounge. She focuses on healthspan intelligence infrastructure, intellectual property, data systems and commercialization, convening founders, investors, scientists and operators to examine the decisions behind enduring companies.

​Succedia Ventures

​Succedia Ventures is a Silicon Valley venture capital firm backing the infrastructure that will define the next generation of healthspan innovation. Legacy Lounge is the community powered by Succedia Ventures.

​EVENT PARTNERS

​FLEX — Co-host

​FLEX builds financial tools for business owners, spanning business spending, payments and financing. As co-host of this Legacy Lounge salon, FLEX brings a practical perspective on the financial decisions behind building and growing a business.

​Capital Green — Official Partner

​Capital Green focuses on Portuguese private credit and financing for businesses in Portugal’s real economy. As an Official Partner of this salon, Capital Green supports thoughtful dialogue among entrepreneurs, investors and operators with an international perspective.

​​COMMUNITY PARTNER

​Newmark

​Newmark is the world’s leading commercial real estate advisor, connecting visionary companies with the spaces that shape innovation.

​Funding Breakthrough Lab is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit pre-accelerator for exceptional founders with expertise. A 25K+ community. Apply to qualify for next cohort Nov 15 deadline.

​Sisters Female Founders is a global community empowering women founders to build globally competitive startups.

​Crewbase Collective (Founded by Saurabh Khire) is organization running hackathons and events across the San Francisco.

About Event

Agenda
6:00 PM: Doors open

6:30 to 7:15 PM: Panel

After that: Free conversation and networking

"The way to get startup ideas is not to try to think of startup ideas. It's to look for problems, preferably problems you have yourself." Paul Graham

Most people who want to build something sit in a room and brainstorm ideas. That is the wrong starting point.

The right starting point is a real problem. That is the ITCH worth scratching.

If you do not have that problem yourself, come find it here. ITCH is a panel discussion with business owners or industry experts in the SF community. We dig into what is actually hard in their business right now. Together, we find the ITCH.

You leave with a list of real problems you can actually work on. And some of the panelists might let you pilot your solution with them directly.You can find ways to leverage AI for these problems.

Industry
We're inviting a San Francisco retail owner who runs a physical clothing store and also designs and manufactures their own clothing line.

ITCHATHON
Two days later we run the ITCHATHON, a hackathon where we solve the problems we found here. Sign up for that too →

This is for anyone who wants to build something. A startup, a side project, or just something for your CV. Up to you.

Come and leave with an ITCH.September 24th, 6 PM
